request.title: ubc2021-04 RFP transformation plate observations and retransformation

sample: plates from Madina, Taylor, and Janella’s transformation on July 5th
result: The two with 2019 RFP plasmid (17ng/ul, with volumes 5ul and 12ul) worked and had red colonies, but the plates had way too much growth.
the 2017 10pg test kit worked, but had few colonies.
2 with 2019 RFP plasmid that was left out (118ng/ul) had growth but colonies were not red, indicating a problem with plasmid or plates.
